verses.text: For the choir director. A Psalm of David. O LORD, You have searched me and known [me].
verses.textZh: （大衛的詩，交與伶長。）耶和華啊，你已經鑒察我，認識我。

verses.text: You know when I sit down and when I rise up; You understand my thought from afar.
verses.textZh: 我坐下，我起來，你都曉得；你從遠處知道我的意念。

verses.text: You scrutinize my path and my lying down, And are intimately acquainted with all my ways.
verses.textZh: 我行路，我躺臥，你都細察；你也深知我一切所行的。

verses.text: Even before there is a word on my tongue, Behold, O LORD, You know it all.
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，我舌頭上的話，你沒有一句不知道的。

verses.text: You have enclosed me behind and before, And laid Your hand upon me.
verses.textZh: 你在我前後環繞我，按手在我身上。

verses.text: [Such] knowledge is too wonderful for me; It is [too] high, I cannot attain to it.
verses.textZh: 這樣的知識奇妙，是我不能測的，至高，是我不能及的。

verses.text: Where can I go from Your Spirit? Or where can I flee from Your presence?
verses.textZh: 我往哪裡去躲避你的靈？我往哪裡逃、躲避你的面？

verses.text: If I ascend to heaven, You are there; If I make my bed in Sheol, behold, You are there.
verses.textZh: 我若升到天上，你在那裡；我若在陰間下榻，你也在那裡。

verses.text: If I take the wings of the dawn, If I dwell in the remotest part of the sea,
verses.textZh: 我若展開清晨的翅膀，飛到海極居住，

verses.text: Even there Your hand will lead me, And Your right hand will lay hold of me.
verses.textZh: 就是在那裡，你的手必引導我；你的右手也必扶持我。

verses.text: If I say, 'Surely the darkness will overwhelm me, And the light around me will be night,'
verses.textZh: 我若說：黑暗必定遮蔽我，我周圍的亮光必成為黑夜；

verses.text: Even the darkness is not dark to You, And the night is as bright as the day. Darkness and light are alike [to You].
verses.textZh: 黑暗也不能遮蔽我，使你不見，黑夜卻如白晝發亮。黑暗和光明，在你看都是一樣。

verses.text: For You formed my inward parts; You wove me in my mother's womb.
verses.textZh: 我的肺腑是你所造的；我在母腹中，你已覆庇我。

verses.text: I will give thanks to You, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made; Wonderful are Your works, And my soul knows it very well.
verses.textZh: 我要稱謝你，因我受造，奇妙可畏；你的作為奇妙，這是我心深知道的。

verses.text: My frame was not hidden from You, When I was made in secret, [And] skillfully wrought in the depths of the earth;
verses.textZh: 我在暗中受造，在地的深處被聯絡；那時，我的形體並不向你隱藏。

verses.text: Your eyes have seen my unformed substance; And in Your book were all written The days that were ordained [for me], When as yet there was not one of them.
verses.textZh: 我未成形的體質，你的眼早已看見了；你所定的日子，我尚未度一日（或譯：我被造的肢體尚未有其一），你都寫在你的冊上了。

verses.text: How precious also are Your thoughts to me, O God! How vast is the sum of them!
verses.textZh: 神啊，你的意念向我何等寶貴！其數何等眾多！

verses.text: If I should count them, they would outnumber the sand. When I awake, I am still with You.
verses.textZh: 我若數點，比海沙更多；我睡醒的時候，仍和你同在。

verses.text: O that You would slay the wicked, O God; Depart from me, therefore, men of bloodshed.
verses.textZh: 神啊，你必要殺戮惡人；所以，你們好流人血的，離開我去罷！

verses.text: For they speak against You wickedly, And Your enemies take [Your name] in vain.
verses.textZh: 因為他們說惡言頂撞你；你的仇敵也妄稱你的名。

verses.text: Do I not hate those who hate You, O LORD? And do I not loathe those who rise up against You?
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，恨惡你的，我豈不恨惡他們麼？攻擊你的，我豈不憎嫌他們麼？

verses.text: I hate them with the utmost hatred; They have become my enemies.
verses.textZh: 我切切地恨惡他們，以他們為仇敵。

verses.text: Search me, O God, and know my heart; Try me and know my anxious thoughts;
verses.textZh: 神啊，求你鑒察我，知道我的心思，試煉我，知道我的意念，

verses.text: And see if there be any hurtful way in me, And lead me in the everlasting way.
verses.textZh: 看在我裡面有甚麼惡行沒有，引導我走永生的道路。
